title: HashiCorp Vault Service token: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix namespace: hvx. vs the three documented prefixes hvs./hvb./hvr.. Twin of "HashiCorp Vault Service token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of vault-token-service-plain: prefix namespace: hvx. vs the three documented prefixes hvs./hvb./hvr.. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
